# Burak Arı

> Mechanical engineer, law graduate and data scientist, bringing law, engineering and data to the same table. Turkish version: https://burakari.com/ · English version: https://burakari.com/en/

Burak Arı is based in Istanbul. Today I work on e-commerce analytics, conversion optimization, AI projects and Shopify apps.

## Background

- Engineering: Yıldız Technical University, Mechanical Engineering. This is where I learned to take systems apart, measure them and put them back together. After graduating, I worked in aviation as an aircraft maintenance engineer.
- Aerospace: Istanbul Technical University, MSc program in Aerospace Engineering. I worked on flight dynamics, control systems and structural mechanics, and spent time in academia as a research assistant. My research interest: how composite structures behave under blast loads.
- Law: Marmara University Faculty of Law, 2026. I learned how rules are written and how they are read. My drive to build bridges between the technical world and the law took shape here.
- Data: Today. With data science and AI, I bring these three fields to one table: asking the right question, measuring, and letting the numbers make the call.

## Focus

- Data science and AI: I turn messy data into decisions. On an e-commerce site, I find where visitors get stuck, measure it and fix it. (E-commerce analytics and conversion rate optimization (CRO); GA4, dashboards and reporting automation; AI and machine learning projects; Shopify app development)
- Law and technology: I translate between technical teams and the law, helping products, data and processes get built in line with regulation. (KVKK (Turkish data protection) compliance documentation; Contracts and operational documents; Analysis of regulatory and compliance data; Legal compliance in technical projects)
- Engineering: I break a problem into parts, model it and find the weakest link. A discipline I picked up in aviation, and one I use in everything I do. (Flight dynamics and control systems; Structural mechanics and composite materials; Aircraft maintenance engineering; İHA-1 drone pilot license)
